```{r Coeficient_of_Determination_vs_Pearson_Rho}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)

set.seed(2025)

n        <- 200
noise_sd <- c(0.1, 0.3)
slopes   <- c(0.3, 1)
df1 <- data.frame(truth=rnorm(n), slope=slopes[1]) %>%
  mutate(predicted=slopes[1]*truth)
df1$predicted <- df1$predicted + rnorm(n, 0, sd=noise_sd[1])
df2 <- data.frame(truth=rnorm(n), slope=slopes[2]) %>%
  mutate(predicted=slopes[2]*truth)
df2$predicted <- df2$predicted + rnorm(n, 0, sd=noise_sd[2])
df <- bind_rows(df1, df2) %>%
  group_by(slope) %>%
  mutate(
    truth_c = truth - mean(truth),
    pred_c  = predicted - mean(predicted)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
metrics <- df %>%
  group_by(slope) %>%
  summarize(
    R = cor(truth_c, pred_c),
    R2 = 1 - sum((truth_c - pred_c)^2) / sum(truth_c^2)
  )%>%
  mutate(label = paste0(": R=", round(R,2), ", R²=", round(R2,2)),
         r2_neg = R2 < 0.5
)
df <- df %>%
  left_join(metrics %>% select(slope, label, r2_neg), by = "slope")
rng <- range(c(df$truth_c, df$pred_c))
pad <- 0.05 * diff(rng)                  
lims <- c(rng[1] - pad-1, rng[2] + pad+1)

p_base <- ggplot(df, aes(truth_c, pred_c, group = label)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE,
              colour = "black", linewidth = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(colour = r2_neg), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
              se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = r2_neg, alpha = r2_neg),
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.20, "FALSE" = 0.35), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Mean-centered Truth",
    y = "Mean-centered Predicted"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 30, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    panel.grid         = element_blank(),
    panel.border       = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(),
    axis.line.y.left   = element_line(),
    axis.line.x.top    = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y.right  = element_blank(),
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "black", margin = margin(t = 50)),
    axis.title         = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    plot.margin        = margin(10, 60, 10, 10)
  )

label_df <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    x_end = max(truth_c),
    fit   = list(lm(pred_c ~ truth_c, data = dplyr::cur_data())),
    R     = cor(truth_c, pred_c),
    R2    = 1 - sum((truth_c - pred_c)^2) / sum(truth_c^2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    intercept = purrr::map_dbl(fit, ~coef(.x)[1]),
    slope     = purrr::map_dbl(fit, ~coef(.x)[2]),
    y_end     = intercept + slope * x_end,
    lab_html  = ifelse(
      R2 < 0,
      sprintf("ρ=%.2f, <span style='color:red;'>R²=%.2f</span>", R, R2),
      sprintf("ρ=%.2f, R²=%.2f", R, R2)
    )
  )

g <- p_base +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = lims, ylim = lims, expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(floor(lims[1]), ceiling(lims[2]), by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(floor(lims[1]), ceiling(lims[2]), by = 1)) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data        = label_df,
    aes(x = x_end, y = y_end, label = lab_html),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill        = NA,
    label.color = NA,
    nudge_x     = 0.1,
    hjust       = 0,
    size        = 5,
    fontface    = "bold"
  )

print(g)

dir.create("plots/supplementalfigures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(
  filename = "plots/supplementalfigures/supplementalpearsonRvsR2_6.pdf",
  plot     = g,
  device   = cairo_pdf,
  width    = 20,
  height   = 15,
  dpi      = 300
)
```

```{r load, install, and run MLP}
# ----- Load functions -----
source("mlscale/mlscale/R/studycharacteristics.R")
source("mlscale/mlscale/R/functions.R")
source("mlscale/mlscale/R/helperfunctions.R")

# ----- Unzip all zip files in the mlscale folder -----
unzip_all_in_dir("mlscale/mlscale/data/")

# ----- Load datasets from repo -----
load("mlscale/mlscale/data/datasetsfromrepo.RData")
microbialscalerepository$`Morton2019 16S` <- microbialscalerepository$Morton2019
microbialscalerepository$`Contijoch2019 16S` <- microbialscalerepository$Contijoch2019

# ---- subset Alessandri2024 to fecal / Vaginal ----
subset_study <- function(study_entry, samples_to_keep) {
  study_entry$counts$original <- 
    study_entry$counts$original[rownames(study_entry$counts$original) %in% samples_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$counts$reprocessed$MetaPhlAn4 <- 
    study_entry$counts$reprocessed$MetaPhlAn4[
      rownames(study_entry$counts$reprocessed$MetaPhlAn4) %in% samples_to_keep, 
    , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$proportions$original <- 
    study_entry$proportions$original[rownames(study_entry$proportions$original) %in% samples_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$proportions$reprocessed$MetaPhlAn4 <- 
    study_entry$proportions$reprocessed$MetaPhlAn4[
      rownames(study_entry$proportions$reprocessed$MetaPhlAn4) %in% samples_to_keep, 
    , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$scale    <- study_entry$scale    %>% filter(Sample %in% samples_to_keep)
  study_entry$metadata <- study_entry$metadata %>% filter(Sample %in% samples_to_keep)
  study_entry
}

md    <- microbialscalerepository$Alessandri2024$metadata
fecal <- md %>% filter(env_broad_scale == "Fecal")      %>% pull(Sample)
vaginal    <- md %>% filter(env_broad_scale == "Vaginal swab") %>% pull(Sample)
microbialscalerepository$Alessandri2024_fecal   <- 
  subset_study(microbialscalerepository$Alessandri2024, fecal)
microbialscalerepository$Alessandri2024_vaginal <- 
  subset_study(microbialscalerepository$Alessandri2024, vaginal)

# ---- subset Vandeputte2017 to Disease and Study Cohort ----
subset_study <- function(study_entry, samples_to_keep) {
  study_entry$counts$original$rdp16 <- 
    study_entry$counts$original$rdp16[rownames(study_entry$counts$original$rdp16) %in% samples_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$counts$reprocessed$rdp16 <- 
    study_entry$counts$reprocessed$rdp16[
      rownames(study_entry$counts$reprocessed$rdp16) %in% samples_to_keep, 
    , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$counts$original$rdp19 <- 
    study_entry$counts$original$rdp19[rownames(study_entry$counts$original$rdp19) %in% samples_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$counts$reprocessed$rdp19 <- 
    study_entry$counts$reprocessed$rdp19[
      rownames(study_entry$counts$reprocessed$rdp19) %in% samples_to_keep, 
    , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$proportions$nishijima2024 <- 
    study_entry$proportions$nishijima2024[rownames(study_entry$proportions$nishijima2024) %in% samples_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$proportions$original$rdp16 <- 
    study_entry$proportions$original$rdp16[rownames(study_entry$proportions$original$rdp16) %in% samples_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$proportions$reprocessed$rdp16 <- 
    study_entry$proportions$reprocessed$rdp16[
      rownames(study_entry$proportions$reprocessed$rdp16) %in% samples_to_keep, 
    , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$proportions$original$rdp19 <- 
    study_entry$proportions$original$rdp19[rownames(study_entry$proportions$original$rdp19) %in% samples_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$proportions$reprocessed$rdp19 <- 
    study_entry$proportions$reprocessed$rdp19[
      rownames(study_entry$proportions$reprocessed$rdp19) %in% samples_to_keep, 
    , drop = FALSE]
  study_entry$scale    <- study_entry$scale    %>% filter(Sample %in% samples_to_keep)
  study_entry$metadata <- study_entry$metadata %>% filter(Sample %in% samples_to_keep)
  study_entry
}

md    <- microbialscalerepository$Vandeputte2017$metadata
diseasecohort <- md %>% filter(Cohort == "Disease cohort")      %>% pull(Sample)
studycohort    <- md %>% filter(Cohort == "Study cohort") %>% pull(Sample)
microbialscalerepository$`Vandeputte2017 Disease Cohort`   <- 
  subset_study(microbialscalerepository$Vandeputte2017, diseasecohort)
microbialscalerepository$`Vandeputte2017 Study Cohort` <- 
  subset_study(microbialscalerepository$Vandeputte2017, studycohort)

# ----- Load proportions and metadata from Global2024 -----
proportions_dir <- "mlscale/mlscale/data/Global_2024_counts/"  # contains *_shotgunmetagenomics.csv
metadata_dir    <- "mlscale/mlscale/data/Global2024/"     # contains *_metadata.csv
strip_suffix <- function(filename, suffix) {
  sub(paste0(suffix, "\\.csv$"), "", basename(filename))
}
template <- list(
  sequencingtype = "Shotgun Metagenomics",
  loadtype = "Flow Cytometry",
  organismtype = "Human",
  sampletype = "Fecal",
  covariates = NULL,
  ID = NULL,
  PMID = NULL
)
proportions_files <- list.files(proportions_dir, pattern = "_shotgunmetagenomics\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
proportion_names <- strip_suffix(proportions_files, "_shotgunmetagenomics")
for (i in seq_along(proportion_names)) {
  dataset_name <- proportion_names[i]
  microbialscalerepository[[dataset_name]]$proportions$original$motus25 <- 
    read.csv(proportions_files[i], row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>% as.data.frame()
}
metadata_files <- list.files(metadata_dir, pattern = "_metadata\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
metadata_names <- strip_suffix(metadata_files, "_metadata") %>%
  sub("^(Global)(2024)", "\\1_\\2", .)
for (i in seq_along(metadata_names)) {
  dataset_name <- metadata_names[i]
  microbialscalerepository[[dataset_name]]$metadata$original$motus25 <- 
    read.csv(metadata_files[i], row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>% as.data.frame()
}
all_dataset_names <- union(proportion_names, metadata_names)
for (dataset_name in all_dataset_names) {
  if (!dataset_name %in% names(datasets)) {
    datasets[[dataset_name]] <- template
  }
}

# ----- Install and load MLP package -----
setwd("mlscale/mlscale/R/microbial_load_predictor")
if (!require("devtools")) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::document()
devtools::install_local("mlscale/mlscale/R/microbial_load_predictor")
library(MLP)


process_mlp_predictions <- function(datasets, repo) {
  old_warn <- options(warn = 1)
  on.exit(options(old_warn))
  run_16s <- function(df, path) {
    if (is.null(df) || length(df) < 1 || nrow(df) < 1) return(NULL)
    message("Processing ", paste(path, collapse = " → "))
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(across(
        everything(),
        ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
      ))
    df <- df[rowSums(df) > 0, colSums(df) > 0]
    if (nrow(df) < 1 || ncol(df) < 1) {
      message("No data to process")
      return(NULL)
    }
    total    <- length(as.matrix(df))
    nonzero  <- sum(df != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    sparsity <- (total - nonzero) / total * 100
    row_sparsity <- apply(df, 1, function(x) mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
    rdpclassifier <- readRDS("inst/extdata/16S_rRNA/model.16S_rRNA.rds")
    referencetaxa <- names(rdpclassifier$trainingData)
    if (any(c("Shannon diversity", ".outcome") %in% referencetaxa)) {
      referencetaxa <- setdiff(referencetaxa, c("Shannon diversity", ".outcome"))
    }
    samplesparsity <- compute_sparsity_per_sample(df, referencetaxa)
    if (mean(samplesparsity == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0.95) {
      print(paste("Model features for dataset are almost completely sparse:", mean(samplesparsity == 1, na.rm = TRUE)))
    }
    overlap_prop    <- prop_presenttaxa_overlap_per_sample(df, referencetaxa)
    nonoverlap_prop <- prop_taxa_notusedinmodel_per_sample(df, referencetaxa)
    psuedocount <- compute_psuedocount(df, referencetaxa)
    observed <- compute_observed(df)
    shannon <- compute_shannon(df)
    simpson <- compute_simpson(df)
    evenness <- compute_evenness(df, observed)
    df2 <- model_relative_abundances(df, referencetaxa)
    alpha_df <- compute_alpha_diversity(df2)
    rare_taxa <- evaluate_rare_taxa(df2)
    #ace <- compute_ace(df2)
    berger_parker <- compute_berger_parker(df2)
    inv_simpson <- compute_inv_simpson(df2)
    #chao1  <- compute_chao1(df2)
    rank_abundance_slope <- compute_rank_abundance_slope(df2)
    #pareto_alpha <- compute_pareto_alpha(df2)
    kurtosis <- compute_kurtosis(df2)
    skewness <- compute_skewness(df2)
    top_taxa <- get_top_taxa_per_sample(df2, top_n = 1)
    msg <- capture.output(
      tmp_res <- MLP(df,"rdp_train_set_16 (16S rRNA)", "load"),
      type = "message"
    )
    res <- tmp_res
    if (!is.null(res)) {
      full_msg <- paste(msg, collapse = " ")
      m        <- regexec("([0-9]+)\\D*([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*)\\s*%", full_msg)
      mm       <- regmatches(full_msg, m)[[1]]
      if (length(mm) >= 3) {
        res$model_says_sharedtaxa         <- as.integer(mm[2])
        res$model_says_sharedtaxa_percent <- as.numeric(mm[3])
      } else {
        res$model_says_sharedtaxa         <- NA_integer_
        res$model_says_sharedtaxa_percent <- NA_real_
      }
      res$dataset_sparsity_percent <- sparsity
      res$sample_sparsity_percent_alltaxa <- row_sparsity
      freqs <- table(res$load)
      mode_value <- as.numeric(names(freqs)[which.max(freqs)])
      mode_freq  <- max(freqs)
      mode_pct   <- mode_freq / length(res$load) * 100
      res$mode_of_load               <- mode_value
      res$modefrequencyofload        <- mode_freq
      res$modefrequencyofload_percent <- mode_pct
      res$profile      <- "rdp"
      res$training_set <- "Vandeputte2021"
      res$log10_mlp    <- log10(res$load)
      res$log2_mlp     <- log2(res$load)
      res <- res %>% rename(mlp = load)
      res <- cbind(
        res,
        sample_sparsity_percent = samplesparsity*100,
        observed = observed,
        shannon = shannon,
        simpson = simpson,
        evenness = evenness,
        psuedocount = psuedocount,
        alpha_df,
        rare_taxa_percent = rare_taxa/alpha_df$Observed_modelfeatures * 100,
        taxa_used_in_model_percent    = overlap_prop*100,
        taxa_not_used_in_model_percent = nonoverlap_prop*100,
        #ace = ace,
        berger_parker = berger_parker,
        inv_simpson = inv_simpson,
        #chao1 = chao1,
        rank_abundance_slope = rank_abundance_slope,
        #pareto_alpha = pareto_alpha,
        kurtosis = kurtosis,
        skewness = skewness,
        top_taxa = top_taxa
      )
      train_data <- rdpclassifier$trainingData
      mean_baseline_pred <- mean(train_data$.outcome, na.rm = TRUE)
      outcome_var <- ".outcome"
      predictor_vars <- setdiff(colnames(train_data), outcome_var)
      my_formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(predictor_vars, collapse = " + ")))
      lm_model <- lm(my_formula, data = train_data)
      predict_df <- as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = nrow(df), ncol = length(predictor_vars)))
      colnames(predict_df) <- predictor_vars
      rownames(predict_df) <- rownames(df)
      common_cols <- intersect(colnames(df), predictor_vars)
      if(length(common_cols) > 0) {
        predict_df[, common_cols] <- df[, common_cols]
      }
      lm_baseline_pred <- predict(lm_model, newdata = predict_df)
      res$mean_baseline_pred <- mean_baseline_pred
      res$lm_baseline_pred   <- lm_baseline_pred
    }
    res
  }
  run_shotgun <- function(df, path) {
    if (is.null(df) || length(df) < 1 || nrow(df) < 1) return(NULL)
    message("Processing ", paste(path, collapse = " → "))
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(across(
        everything(),
        ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
      ))
    df <- df[rowSums(df) > 0, colSums(df) > 0]
    if (nrow(df) < 1 || ncol(df) < 1) {
      message("No data to process")
      return(NULL)
    }
    total    <- length(as.matrix(df))
    nonzero  <- sum(df != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    sparsity <- (total - nonzero) / total * 100
    row_sparsity <- apply(df, 1, function(x) mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
    profiles      <- c(
      "motus25", 
      "metaphlan4.mpa_vJun23_CHOCOPhlAnSGB_202403"
    )
    training_sets <- c("metacardis", "galaxy")
    preds <- list()
    for (prof in profiles) {
      for (ts in training_sets) {
        message("Processing ", paste(c(path, prof, ts), collapse = " → "))
        model_path <- file.path(
          "inst/extdata/",
          ts,
          paste0("model.", prof, ".rds")
        )
        if (file.exists(model_path)) {
          model <- readRDS(model_path)
          referencetaxa <- names(model$trainingData)
          if (any(c("Shannon diversity", ".outcome") %in% referencetaxa)) {
            referencetaxa <- setdiff(referencetaxa, c("Shannon diversity", ".outcome"))
          }
        } else {
          warning("Missing model file: ", model_path)
          referencetaxa <- character(0)
        }
        colnames(df) <- colnames(df) %>% str_replace("unassigned", "-1")
        colnames(df) <- colnames(df) %>% str_replace("UNCLASSIFIED", "-1")
        samplesparsity <- compute_sparsity_per_sample(df, referencetaxa)
        if (mean(samplesparsity == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0.95) {
          print(paste("Model features for dataset are almost completely sparse:", mean(samplesparsity == 1, na.rm = TRUE)))
        }
        overlap_prop    <- prop_presenttaxa_overlap_per_sample(df, referencetaxa)
        nonoverlap_prop <- prop_taxa_notusedinmodel_per_sample(df, referencetaxa)
        psuedocount <- compute_psuedocount(df, referencetaxa)
        observed <- compute_observed(df)
        shannon <- compute_shannon(df)
        simpson <- compute_simpson(df)
        evenness <- compute_evenness(df, observed)
        df2 <- model_relative_abundances(df, referencetaxa)
        alpha_df <- compute_alpha_diversity(df2)
        rare_taxa <- evaluate_rare_taxa(df2)
        #ace <- compute_ace(df2)
        berger_parker <- compute_berger_parker(df2)
        inv_simpson <- compute_inv_simpson(df2)
        #chao1  <- compute_chao1(df2)
        rank_abundance_slope <- compute_rank_abundance_slope(df2)
        #pareto_alpha <- compute_pareto_alpha(df2)
        kurtosis <- compute_kurtosis(df2)
        skewness <- compute_skewness(df2)
        top_taxa <- get_top_taxa_per_sample(df2, top_n = 1)
        msg <- capture.output(
          tmp_res <- MLP(df, ts, "load", profiler = prof),
          type = "message"
        )
        res <- tmp_res
        if (!is.null(res)) {
          full_msg <- paste(msg, collapse = " ")
          m        <- regexec("([0-9]+)\\D*([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*)\\s*%", full_msg)
          mm       <- regmatches(full_msg, m)[[1]]
          if (length(mm) >= 3) {
            res$model_says_sharedtaxa         <- as.integer(mm[2])
            res$model_says_sharedtaxa_percent <- as.numeric(mm[3])
          } else {
            res$model_says_sharedtaxa         <- NA_integer_
            res$model_says_sharedtaxa_percent <- NA_real_
          }
          res$dataset_sparsity_percent <- sparsity
          res$sample_sparsity_percent_alltaxa <- row_sparsity
          freqs <- table(res$load)
          mode_value <- as.numeric(names(freqs)[which.max(freqs)])
          mode_freq  <- max(freqs)
          mode_pct   <- mode_freq / length(res$load) * 100
          res$mode_of_load               <- mode_value
          res$modefrequencyofload        <- mode_freq
          res$modefrequencyofload_percent <- mode_pct
          res$profile      <- prof
          res$training_set <- ts
          res$log10_mlp    <- log10(res$load)
          res$log2_mlp     <- log2(res$load)
          res <- res %>% rename(mlp = load)
          res <- cbind(
            res,
            sample_sparsity_percent = samplesparsity*100,
            observed = observed,
            shannon = shannon,
            simpson = simpson,
            evenness = evenness,
            psuedocount = psuedocount,
            alpha_df,
            rare_taxa_percent = rare_taxa/alpha_df$Observed_modelfeatures * 100,
            taxa_used_in_model_percent    = overlap_prop*100,
            taxa_not_used_in_model_percent = nonoverlap_prop*100,
            #ace = ace,
            berger_parker = berger_parker,
            inv_simpson = inv_simpson,
            #chao1 = chao1,
            rank_abundance_slope = rank_abundance_slope,
            #pareto_alpha = pareto_alpha,
            kurtosis = kurtosis,
            skewness = skewness,
            top_taxa = top_taxa
          )
          train_data <- model$trainingData
          mean_baseline_pred <- mean(train_data$.outcome, na.rm = TRUE)
          outcome_var <- ".outcome"
          predictor_vars <- setdiff(colnames(train_data), outcome_var)
          quoted_predictor_vars <- paste0("`", predictor_vars, "`")
          my_formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(quoted_predictor_vars, collapse = " + ")))
          lm_model <- lm(my_formula, data = train_data)
          predict_df <- as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = nrow(df), ncol = length(predictor_vars)))
          colnames(predict_df) <- predictor_vars
          rownames(predict_df) <- rownames(df)
          common_cols <- intersect(colnames(df), predictor_vars)
          if (length(common_cols) > 0) {
              predict_df[, common_cols] <- df[, common_cols]
          }
          lm_baseline_pred <- predict(lm_model, newdata = predict_df)
          res$mean_baseline_pred <- mean_baseline_pred
          res$lm_baseline_pred <- lm_baseline_pred
          preds[[length(preds) + 1L]] <- res
        }
      }
    }
    if (length(preds)) bind_rows(preds) else NULL
  }
  recurse <- function(node, path, runner) {
    if (is.data.frame(node)) return(runner(node, path))
    if (is.list(node)) {
      out <- lapply(names(node), function(nm)
        recurse(node[[nm]], c(path, nm), runner))
      names(out) <- names(node)
      out[lengths(out) == 0] <- NULL
      return(out)
    }
    NULL
  }
  results <- list()
  for (dn in names(datasets)) {
    seqtype <- tolower(datasets[[dn]]$sequencingtype %||% "")
    runner <- switch(
      seqtype,
      "amplicon"             = run_16s,
      "16s rrna"             = run_16s,
      "16s rna"              = run_16s,
      "16srna"               = run_16s,
      "16s"                  = run_16s,
      "metagenome"           = run_shotgun,
      "metagenomic"          = run_shotgun,
      "metagenomics"         = run_shotgun,
      "shotgun"              = run_shotgun,
      "shotgun metagenomics" = run_shotgun,
      stop("Unknown sequencing type: ", seqtype)
    )
    prop_root <- repo[[dn]]$proportions
    if (is.null(prop_root)) next
    preds <- list()
    for (ptype in names(prop_root)) {
      prop_data <- prop_root[[ptype]]
      if (is.null(prop_data)) next
      pr <- recurse(prop_data, c(dn, ptype), runner)
      if (!is.null(pr)) preds[[ptype]] <- pr
    }
    if (length(preds) == 0) next
    study <- repo[[dn]]
    study$studydemographics <- datasets[[dn]]
    study$predictions       <- preds
    results[[dn]]           <- study
  }
  return(results)
}
```

```{r Load Distributions and Supplemental Figures}
tidyplot_theme <- function(base_size = 18) {  
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Arial", color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                                margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), hjust = 0.5),  
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10), hjust = 0.5), 
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),  
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

# ----- Load Ridge Distribution plots -----
tidyplot_theme <- function(base_size = 18) {  
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text               = element_text(family = "Arial", color = "black"),
      plot.title         = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold",
                                        hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y       = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title         = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
      axis.text          = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.line          = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length  = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid         = element_blank(),
      panel.border       = element_blank(),
      plot.margin        = unit(c(1,1,1,1), "cm"),
      legend.position    = "top",
      legend.title       = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

      str_detect(TrainingSet, regex("vandeputte",TRUE)) ~ "Predicted (Vandeputte2021)",

  )

special_labels <- c("GALAXY", "MetaCardis", "Vandeputte2021", "Vandeputte2017", "Vandeputte2017 Disease Cohort", "Vandeputte2017 Study Cohort")    
special_colors <- c("#0C58CA", "#FF8C27", "#1B1B1B", "#1B1B1B", "#1B1B1B", "#1B1B1B")  

label_formatter <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(lbl) {
    i <- match(lbl, special_labels)
    if (!is.na(i)) {
      sprintf("<b><span style='color:%s'>%s</span></b>",
              special_colors[i], lbl)
    } else {
      lbl
    }
  }, character(1))
}

ridge_panel <- function(df, title_txt, x_limits, show_x = TRUE) {
  offset <- diff(x_limits) * 0.02
  arrow_df <- df %>%
  group_by(RidgeLabel, Source) %>%
  summarise(
    any_left  = any(Load_norm < x_limits[1]),
    any_right = any(Load_norm > x_limits[2]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(any_left, any_right),
               names_to  = "side",
               values_to = "flag") %>%
  filter(flag) %>%
  mutate(
    xstart = if_else(side == "any_left",
                     x_limits[1] + offset,
                     x_limits[2] - offset),
    xend   = if_else(side == "any_left",
                     x_limits[1],
                     x_limits[2])
  )
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Load_norm, y = RidgeLabel, fill = Source)) +
    geom_density_ridges(
      data = df[df$Source == "Measured", ],
      aes(x = Load_norm, y = RidgeLabel, fill = Source, height = ..scaled..),
      stat = "density",
      scale = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.9,
      rel_min_height = 0.001,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_density_ridges(
    data = df[df$Source != "Measured", ],
    aes(x = Load_norm, y = RidgeLabel, fill = Source, height = ..scaled..),
    stat = "density",
    scale = 1,
    alpha = 0.9,
    rel_min_height = 0.001,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_cols, guide = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title_txt,
      x     = if (show_x)
                expression("Mean Centered"~log[10]~"Microbial Load")
              else
                NULL,
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = label_formatter,
      expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0))
    )+ 
    theme_minimal(base_size   = 18,
                  base_family = "Arial") +
    theme_ridges() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      text             = element_text(family = "Arial"),
      axis.title.x   = if (show_x) element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t=10), size = 20) else element_blank(),
      axis.line       = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      axis.ticks     = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line.y  = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.text.y    = element_markdown(size = 18, vjust=0.5),
      axis.text.x    = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major.y  = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x  = element_line(color = "grey70", size = 0.2)
    )
}

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

G_meas  <- shotgun_data %>% filter(Dataset=="GALAXY",     Source=="Measured")           %>% pull(Load)
G_predM <- shotgun_data %>% filter(Dataset=="GALAXY",     Source=="Predicted (MetaCardis)") %>% pull(Load)
M_meas  <- shotgun_data %>% filter(Dataset=="MetaCardis", Source=="Measured")           %>% pull(Load)
M_predG <- shotgun_data %>% filter(Dataset=="MetaCardis", Source=="Predicted (GALAXY)") %>% pull(Load)
compare_groups <- function(x, y, paired, label) {
  tt <- wilcox.test(x, y, paired = paired, exact = FALSE)
  d  <- cohen.d(x, y, paired = paired)
  tibble(
    comparison = label,
    mean1      = mean(x),
    mean2      = mean(y),
    diff       = mean1 - mean2,
    sd1        = sd(x),
    sd2        = sd(y),
    t_stat     = unname(tt$statistic),
    df         = unname(tt$parameter),
    p_value    = tt$p.value,
    cohen_d    = d$estimate,
    magnitude  = d$magnitude
  )
}
results <- bind_rows(
  compare_groups(G_meas,  M_meas,  FALSE, "GALAXY Meas vs MetaCardis Meas"),
  compare_groups(G_meas,  M_predG, FALSE,  "GALAXY Meas vs MetaCardis Pred(GALAXY)"),
  compare_groups(M_meas,  G_predM, FALSE,  "MetaCardis Meas vs GALAXY Pred(MetaCardis)"),
  compare_groups(M_meas,  M_predG, TRUE,  "MetaCardis Meas vs MetaCardis Pred(GALAXY)"),
  compare_groups(G_meas, G_predM, TRUE, "GALAXY Meas vs GALAXY Pred(MetaCardis)"),
)
results = results %>% mutate(p_bonf = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni"))
print(results, n = Inf, width = Inf)

load_long <- flatten_repo_to_long(global2024_predictions) %>%

load_long <- load_long %>%

      str_detect(TrainingSet, regex("metacardis",ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Predicted (MetaCardis)",

    RidgeID = paste(Dataset, DataFrame, Profile, sep = " – ")
  )

    is_shotgun = any(Source %in% c("Predicted (GALAXY)","Predicted (MetaCardis)")),

  ) %>%
  mutate(StudyType = if_else(is_shotgun, "Shotgun Metagenomics", "16S rRNA"))

}

# ---- Global Cross Predictions ----
pairedanalysis <- flatten_repo_to_long(global2024_predictions) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Load)) %>%
  mutate(
    Dataset = str_remove(Dataset, fixed("Global_2024_")),
    Dataset = str_remove(Dataset, fixed("motus25"))                   
  ) %>%
  filter(TrainingSet %in% c('galaxy', 'metacardis')) %>%
  mutate(TrainingSet = ifelse(TrainingSet == "galaxy", "GALAXY", TrainingSet),
        TrainingSet = ifelse(TrainingSet == "metacardis", "MetaCardis", TrainingSet)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset, TrainingSet, Load) 

df_wide <- pairedanalysis %>%
  group_by(Dataset,TrainingSet) %>%
  mutate(replicate = row_number(), 
        pred_z = Load - mean(Load)) %>%   
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols      = c(Dataset, replicate),  
    names_from   = TrainingSet,
    values_from  = pred_z
  )

x <- df_wide$GALAXY
y <- df_wide$MetaCardis
mx <- mean(x)
my <- mean(y)
vx <- var(x)
vy <- var(y)
sxy <- cov(x, y)
rho <- sxy / sqrt(vx * vy)
R2_2  <- rho^2
ccc <- (2 * sxy) / (vx + vy + (mx - my)^2)
diffs <- df_wide$GALAXY - df_wide$MetaCardis
means <- (df_wide$GALAXY + df_wide$MetaCardis) / 2
mean_diff <- mean(diffs)
loa <- mean_diff + c(-1.96, 1.96) * sd(diffs) 
loa_str <- sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", loa[1], loa[2])
common_range <- range(c(df_wide$GALAXY, df_wide$MetaCardis), na.rm = TRUE)
h <- ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = GALAXY, y = MetaCardis)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(
    slope     = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype  = "dashed",
    color     = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se     = FALSE,
    color  = "white",
    size   = 1.5  
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se     = TRUE,
    color  = "#D62728",
    size   = 1
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
           label = sprintf("rho == %.2f", rho),
           parse = TRUE, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -1.2, size = 5) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
           label = sprintf("italic(CCC) == %.2f", ccc),
           parse = TRUE, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -3.2, size = 5) +
  
  labs(
    x = "<span style='color:#0C58CA'>GALAXY</span>",
    y = "<span style='color:#FF8C27'>MetaCardis</span>"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family="Arial"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    axis.line          = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks         = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "grey20"),
    legend.position    = "none",
    axis.title.x       = element_markdown(
                           face   = "bold",
                           size   = 18,
                           margin = margin(t = 10)
                         ),
    axis.title.y       = element_markdown(
                           face   = "bold",
                           size   = 18,
                           margin = margin(r = 10)
                         )
  ) +
  coord_fixed(
    ratio = 1,
    xlim  = common_range,
    ylim  = common_range
  )
print(h)
ggsave(
  "plots/supplementalfigures/fig1H-global_meancentered.pdf",
  h,
  width = 6,  
  height = 6,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r metrics comparison}
# --- compute metrics like Pearson r, R2, and RMSE -----
metrics_df <- build_metrics_df(
  predictions_and_demographics,
  exclude_truth_columns = loadcolumnstoremove, 
  exclude_studies       = c("Vandeputte2021","Vandeputte2017"),
  exclude_loadtypes     = c("CFU","MK_spike"),
  verbose               = FALSE
)
study_metrics_df <- metrics_df$study_level
sample_metrics_df <- metrics_df$sample_level
df_base <- study_metrics_df %>% 
  filter(!(study == "Pereira2023" & dataframe == "reprocessed > rdp16"),
         !(study == "Krawczyk2022" & dataframe == "original > rdp16"),
         !(study =="Morton2019 16S" & truth_column == "all_flow_cellsperul_avg"))

testingN <- sample_metrics_df %>%
  filter(!(study == "Pereira2023" & dataframe == "reprocessed > rdp16"),
         !(study == "Krawczyk2022" & dataframe == "original > rdp16"),
         !(study == "Morton2019 16S" & truth_column == "all_flow_cellsperul_avg")) %>%
  distinct(ID, study, .keep_all = TRUE)

sample_metrics_df %>%
  count(training_set) %>%
  arrange(training_set, desc(n))

  group_by(Source) %>%
  summarise(unique_studies = unique(study)), n=Inf)

meta_cols   <- c("study", "dataframe", "truth_column", "Source", "loadtype")
metric_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df_base), meta_cols)
df_long_full <- df_base %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(metric_cols),
    names_to  = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))

df_base_sample <- sample_metrics_df %>% 
  filter(!(study == "Pereira2023" & dataframe == "reprocessed > rdp16"),
         !(study == "Krawczyk2022" & dataframe == "original > rdp16"),
         !(study =="Morton2019 16S" & truth_column == "all_flow_cellsperul_avg"))

df_base_sample2 <- df_base_sample %>%
  mutate(study = ifelse(study == "Vandeputte2017 Disease Cohort", "Vandeputte2017 D.C.", study),
  study = ifelse(study == "Vandeputte2017 Study Cohort", "Vandeputte2017 S.C.", study))
to_label = c("Vandeputte2017 D.C.", "GALAXY", "MetaCardis")
df_density <- df_base_sample2 %>%
  mutate(
    abs_resid = abs(residual),
    Group     = if_else(
                  study %in% to_label,
                  "Nishijima2025 Test Studies",
                  "External Test Studies"
                )
  )

library(scales)

df_summary <- df_density %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1     = quantile(abs_resid, 0.25),
    Median = median(abs_resid),
    Q3     = quantile(abs_resid, 0.75),
    Max    = max(abs_resid)
  )

width_in  <- 6
height_in <- 4
dpi_png   <- 300


df_labels <- df_density %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    x = max(abs_resid),
    y = ecdf(abs_resid)(x)
  )

x_max <- max(df_density$abs_resid)
label_positions <- tibble(
  Group = c(
    "Nishijima2025 Test Studies",
    "External Test Studies"
  ),
  x = x_max * 0.95,               
  y = c(0.05, 0.10)               
)

tt    <- t.test(abs_resid ~ Group, data = df_density)
tval  <- abs(tt$statistic)          
df    <- tt$parameter     
logp_nat <- log(2) + 
            pt(tval, df, lower.tail = FALSE, log.p = TRUE)
exp10    <- floor(logp_nat / log(10))
mantissa <- exp(logp_nat - exp10 * log(10))
p_sci    <- sprintf("%.2f×10^%d", mantissa, exp10)


wilc <- wilcox.test(
  abs_resid ~ Group,
  data     = df_density,
  exact    = FALSE   
)
wilc
pval    <- wilc$p.value
lbl   <- paste0("p < 2.2e-16")

df_density %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    mean           = mean(abs_resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    median         = median(abs_resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd             = sd(abs_resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr            = IQR(abs_resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    min            = min(abs_resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    max            = max(abs_resid, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

p = ggplot(df_density, aes(x = Group, y = abs_resid, fill = Group)) +
  geom_violin(

               "loadtype","training_set", "profile", "Focus")
metric_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df_base_sample2), meta_cols)

df_long_full <- df_base_sample2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(metric_cols),
    names_to  = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Value),
    Metric %in% c("R2", "RMSE", "Pearson_r")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric2 = case_when(
      Metric == "R2"        ~ "R^2",
      Metric == "Pearson_r" ~ "Pearson~rho",
      Metric == "RMSE"     ~ "RMSE"
    ),
    Metric2 = factor(Metric2, levels = c("Pearson~rho", "R^2", "RMSE"))
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    across(c("study", "dataframe", "truth_column",
             "Source", "loadtype", "training_set",
             "profile", "Focus", "Metric", "Metric2")),
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  select(-ID)

  study = ifelse(study == "Vandeputte2017 Study Cohort", "Vandeputte2017 S.C.", study))

library(rstatix)

stat.test <- df_long_full %>%
  group_by(Metric2, Source) %>%
  t_test(Value ~ Focus) %>% 
  adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_significance() %>% 
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Focus") %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = case_when(
      Metric2 %in% c("Pearson~rho", "R^2") ~ 0.8,
      Metric2 == "RMSE" ~ 110,
      TRUE ~ y.position
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(df_long_full, aes(x = Focus, y = Value, fill = Source, group = interaction(Source,Focus))) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(colour = Source, fill = Source),  
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
                 dodge.width  = 0.8,           
                 jitter.width = 0.25,           
                 jitter.height= 0               
               )
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      '<span style=\"color:#1B1B1B\">Vandeputte2021</span>' = "#1B1B1B",
      '<span style=\"color:#0C58CA\">GALAXY</span>'         = "#0C58CA",
      '<span style=\"color:#FF8C27\">MetaCardis</span>'     = "#FF8C27"
    )
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Source),
    fun.data = function(x) {
      n <- length(x)
      m <- median(x)
      if (n > 3) {
        se <- sd(x) / sqrt(n)
        tcrit <- qt(0.975, df = n - 1)
        ci  <- se * tcrit
        data.frame(y    = m,
                   ymin = m - ci,
                   ymax = m + ci)
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    },
    geom     = "errorbar",
    width    = 0.3,                  
    size     = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Source),
    fun      = median,
    geom     = "point",
    shape    = "_",                      
    size     = 6,                        
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  facet_grid2(
    rows        = vars(Metric2),
    cols        = vars(Source),
    scales      = "free_y",
    switch      = "y",
    drop        = FALSE,
    labeller    = labeller(Metric2 = label_parsed)
  ) +
  facetted_pos_scales(
    y = list(
      Metric2 == "Pearson~rho" ~ scale_y_continuous(
                                    limits = c(-1, 1),
                                    breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5),
                                    expand = c(0, 0.05)
                                  ),
      Metric2 == "R^2" ~ scale_y_continuous(
                             limits = c(-1, 1),
                             breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.5),
                             expand = c(0, 0.05)
                           ),
      Metric2 == "RMSE" ~ scale_y_continuous(
                             limits = c(0, 2)
                           )
    )
  )  +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    strip.placement       = "outside",
    strip.text.y.left     = element_text(angle =90, 
                                         face   = "bold",
                                         size   = 16,
                                         color = "black"
                                         ),
    strip.text.x          = element_markdown(face  = "bold",
                                             size  = 16,
                                             margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text.x           = element_markdown(angle  = 45,
                                             hjust  = 1,
                                             vjust  = 1,
                                             face   = "bold",
                                             size = 16, 
                                             color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y    = element_line(color = "grey90", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x    = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing         = unit(2, "lines"),
    axis.line            = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks           = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y          = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
    legend.position      = "none"
  ) + stat_pvalue_manual(
      data        = stat.test,     
      mapping     = aes(
        xmin       = xmin,           
        xmax       = xmax,
        y.position = y.position,
        label      = p              
      ),
      tip.length  = 0.05,
      hide.ns     = FALSE,
      inherit.aes = FALSE            
    )
print(p)
ggsave(
  "plots/performancemetrics/fig1E.pdf",
  p,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r PMID analysis}

predictionandtruthresults$Alessandri2024 = NULL

consortiumdata <- read.csv(
  "/home/maxwellkonnaris/Documents/pennstate/silvermanlab/mlscale/mlscale/data/publication_data.csv",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (!"PMID" %in% colnames(consortiumdata) || !"Consortium" %in% colnames(consortiumdata)) {
  stop("consortiumdata must have columns named 'PMID' and 'consortium'")
}

new_predictionandtruthresults = list()
for (study_name in names(predictionandtruthresults)) {
  info <- predictionandtruthresults[[study_name]]$studyinfo
  if (!"PMID" %in% colnames(info)) next 
  if (!"Consortium" %in% colnames(info)) {
    info$Consortium <- NA_character_
  }
  idx      <- match(info$PMID, consortiumdata$PMID)
  new_cons <- consortiumdata$Consortium[idx]
  new_cons[is.na(new_cons) | new_cons == ""] <- NA_character_
  conflict_rows <- which(!is.na(info$Consortium) & !is.na(new_cons))
  if (length(conflict_rows) > 0) {
    for (i in conflict_rows) {
      message(
        sprintf(
          "Study %s | PMID %s: existing consortium = '%s' ; new = '%s'",
          study_name, info$PMID[i],
          info$Consortium[i], new_cons[i]
        )
      )
    }
  }
  info$Consortium <- new_cons
  new_predictionandtruthresults[[study_name]]$studyinfo <- info
  new_predictionandtruthresults[[study_name]]$studydemographics <- predictionandtruthresults[[study_name]]$studydemographics
}

global_id_from_name <- function(raw) {
  sub(
    "^Global_(\\d{4})_([^_]+)_(\\d{4})_.*$",
    "Global\\1 (\\2 \\3)",
    raw
  )
}

global_rows <- grep("^Global2024", consortiumdata$`Study Identifier`)
for (i in global_rows) {
  id <- consortiumdata$`Study Identifier`[i]
  clean_id <- gsub("^Global2024 \\(|\\)$", "", id, perl = TRUE)
  authors_clean <- gsub(",", ";", consortiumdata$Authors[i])
  
  if (id %in% names(new_predictionandtruthresults)) next
  df <- data.frame(
    `Study Identifier` = clean_id,
    PMID            = consortiumdata$PMID[i],
    Authors         = authors_clean,
    Consortium      = consortiumdata$Consortium[i],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names        = FALSE
  )

  new_predictionandtruthresults[[clean_id]] <- list(studyinfo = df, studydemographics = data.frame(sequencingtype = "Shotgun Metagenomics"))
}
```

```{r dataset r2 features}
# ----- r2 by feature plots -----
variables <- c("log10_r2", 
"model_says_sharedtaxa",
"modefrequencyofload_percent")

r2_plot_df <-  
  r2results %>%
  filter(!(truth_column == "FC_cell_g_fresh")) %>%
  mutate(study = ifelse(study == "Vandeputte2017 Disease Cohort", "Vandeputte2017 D.C.", study),
         study = ifelse(study == "Vandeputte2017 Study Cohort", "Vandeputte2017 S.C.", study)
  ) %>%
  select(study, training_set, profile, loadtype, log10_r2, all_of(variables)) %>%
  rename(
    `Shared Taxa (Dataset)`       = "model_says_sharedtaxa",
    `Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)` = "modefrequencyofload_percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    training_set = if_else(training_set == "galaxy",    "GALAXY",    training_set),
    training_set = if_else(training_set == "metacardis","MetaCardis",training_set),
    denom = case_when(
      training_set == "GALAXY"    & profile == "motus25"   ~ 443,
      training_set == "MetaCardis"& profile == "motus25"   ~ 413,
      training_set == "GALAXY"    & profile == "metaphlan4.mpa_vJun23_CHOCOPhlAnSGB_202403"~ 425,
      training_set == "MetaCardis"& profile == "metaphlan4.mpa_vJun23_CHOCOPhlAnSGB_202403"~ 379,
      training_set == "Vandeputte2021" & profile == "rdp"   ~ 194,
      TRUE                                           ~ NA_real_
    ),
    `Shared Taxa (%)` = `Shared Taxa (Dataset)` / denom * 100
  ) %>%
  select(-denom)%>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols       = -c(study, log10_r2,training_set, profile, loadtype),
    names_to   = "metric",
    values_to  = "value"
  )

r2_plot_df_shotgun_galaxy = r2_plot_df %>%
  filter((training_set == "GALAXY"))

r2_plot_df_shotgun_metacardis = r2_plot_df %>%
  filter((training_set == "MetaCardis"))

r2_plot_df_amplicon = r2_plot_df %>%
  filter(!(training_set == "GALAXY"), !(training_set == "MetaCardis"))

featureplots = list(r2_plot_df_shotgun_galaxy, r2_plot_df_shotgun_metacardis, r2_plot_df_amplicon)

counter <- 1L
for (df in featureplots) {
  ts <- unique(df$training_set) 
  g = ggplot(df, aes(x = log10_r2, y = value, fill=training_set)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = training_set),
      shape = 21,
      size  = 2,
      alpha = 0.8,
      stroke = 1.5,
      fill = "white"
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(group = training_set),
      method     = "lm",
      se         = TRUE,
      linetype   = "solid",
      size       = 0,
      alpha = 0.3,
      fill = "grey60"
    )  + 
    geom_smooth(
      aes(group = training_set),   
      method   = "lm",
      se       = FALSE,
      linetype = "solid",
      size     = 1.5,
      color    = "white",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(color = training_set),
      method     = "lm",
      se         = FALSE,
      linetype   = "solid",
      size       = 1
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      rows   = vars(metric),
      cols   = vars(training_set),
      scales = "free",
      switch = "y",
      labeller = labeller(
      training_set = as_labeller(c(
        Vandeputte2021 = "<span style='color:#1B1B1B'>Vandeputte2021</span>",
        GALAXY         = "<span style='color:#0C58CA'>GALAXY</span>",
        MetaCardis     = "<span style='color:#FF8C27'>MetaCardis</span>"
      )))  
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),    
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.025, 0.05))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        Vandeputte2021 = "#1B1B1B",
        GALAXY         = "#0C58CA",
        MetaCardis     = "#FF8C27"
      ),
      labels = c(
        Vandeputte2021 = "<span style='color:#1B1B1B'>Vandeputte2021</span>",
        GALAXY         = "<span style='color:#0C58CA'>GALAXY</span>",
        MetaCardis     = "<span style='color:#FF8C27'>MetaCardis</span>"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        Vandeputte2021 = "#1B1B1B",
        GALAXY         = "#0C58CA",
        MetaCardis     = "#FF8C27"
      )
    ) +
    stat_cor(
      aes(label = paste0(
        "rho==", signif(..r.., 2),    "~",
        "R^2==", signif(..rr..,2)    
      )),
      method      = "pearson",
      parse       = TRUE,           
      label.x   = Inf,    
      label.y   = Inf,   
      hjust       = 1.05,
      vjust       = 1.05,
      size        = 6,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      x = expression(R^2),
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 18, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      strip.placement    = "outside", 
      strip.background.y = element_blank(), 
      strip.text.y.left  = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, size =14, face ="bold"),
      panel.border      = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major  = element_line(color = "grey90", size =0.25),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      panel.aspect.ratio = 1,
      strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      strip.text.x        = element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.text         = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks        = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.title.y      = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain", margin = margin(r = 8)),
      axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 18, face = "plain", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      legend.position   = "none"
    )
    loadtypes <- unique(df$loadtype)
    g <- g + lapply(seq_along(loadtypes), function(i) {
        stat_cor(
          data = df[df$loadtype == loadtypes[i], ],
          aes(label = paste0(
            "'", loadtypes[i], "'",
            "~rho==", "~",
            signif(after_stat(r), 2),
            "~R^2==",
            signif(after_stat(rr),2)
          )),
          method = "pearson",
          parse = TRUE,
          label.x.npc = 0.02,
          label.y.npc = 1 - (i - 1) * 0.04,
          hjust = 0,
          vjust = 1,
          size = 4,
          show.legend = FALSE
        )
      })
    print(g)
    width  <- 4
    height <- 8
    ggsave(paste0("plots/featurecomparisons/fig2D_", counter,".pdf"), g, device = cairo_pdf, width = width, height = height, dpi = 600)
    counter = counter + 1L
}
scatter_df <- r2_plot_df %>%
  filter(metric %in% c("Shared Taxa (%)", "Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = metric,
    values_from = value
  )
for (ts in unique(scatter_df$training_set)) {
  df_sub <- scatter_df %>% filter(training_set == ts)

  # compute Pearson r & OLS R²
  cor_res <- cor.test(
    df_sub$`Shared Taxa (%)`,
    df_sub$`Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)`,
    method = "pearson"
  )
  lm_res <- summary(
    lm(`Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)` ~ `Shared Taxa (%)`, data = df_sub)
  )

  # print to console
  cat("\n===== ", ts, " =====\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("Pearson r = %.3f    p-value = %.3g\n",
              cor_res$estimate, cor_res$p.value))
  cat(sprintf("  OLS R² = %.3f\n", lm_res$r.squared))

  # prepare the label
  lab <- paste0(
    "r = ",   signif(cor_res$estimate,  2), "\n",
    "R\u00B2 = ", signif(lm_res$r.squared, 2)
  )

  # pick a corner for annotation
  x0 <- min(df_sub$`Shared Taxa (%)`, na.rm = TRUE)
  y0 <- max(df_sub$`Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)`, na.rm = TRUE)

  # build the ggplot
  p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(
               x = `Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)`,
               y = `Shared Taxa (%)`
             )) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    annotate("text",
             x      = x0,
             y      = y0,
             label  = lab,
             hjust  = 0,
             vjust  = 1,
             size   = 5,
             family = "Arial"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = ts,
      x     = "Shared Taxa (%)",
      y     = "Predicted Load Frequency (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)

  print(p)
}

  select(
    training_set,
    log10_r2,
    `Shared Taxa (%)`,
    `Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)`
  ) %>%
  drop_na()
for (ts in unique(df_metrics$training_set)) {
  df_sub <- filter(df_metrics, training_set == ts)
  cor_res <- cor.test(df_sub$`Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)`,
                      df_sub$`Shared Taxa (%)`,
                      method = "pearson")
  lm_res  <- summary(
    lm(`Shared Taxa (%)` ~ `Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)`, data = df_sub)
  )
  cat("\n===== ", ts, " =====\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("Pearson r = %.3f    p-value = %.3g\n",
              cor_res$estimate, cor_res$p.value))
  cat(sprintf("  OLS R² = %.3f\n", lm_res$r.squared))
  lab <- paste0(
    "r = ",   signif(cor_res$estimate,  2), "\n",
    "R\u00B2 = ", signif(lm_res$r.squared, 2)
  )
  x0 <- min(df_sub$`Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)`, na.rm = TRUE)
  y0 <- max(df_sub$`Shared Taxa (%)`,            na.rm = TRUE)
  p_swap <- ggplot(df_sub,
                   aes(x = `Predicted Load Frequency (Mode)`,
                       y = `Shared Taxa (%)`)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    annotate("text",
             x     = x0, y    = y0,
             label = lab,
             hjust = 0,  vjust = 1,
             size  = 5,  family = "Arial"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(ts, " (swapped axes)"),
      x     = "Predicted Load Frequency (%)",
      y     = "Shared Taxa (%)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
  print(p_swap)
}

df_metrics <- r2results %>%

  mutate(

      training_set == "galaxy"     ~ "GALAXY",

    ),

      training_set == "MetaCardis" & profile == "metaphlan4.mpa_vJun23_CHOCOPhlAnSGB_202403" ~ 379,
      training_set == "Vandeputte2021" & profile == "rdp"    ~ 194,
      TRUE                                             ~ NA_real_
    ),
    `Shared Taxa (%)`                = model_says_sharedtaxa / denom * 100,

  ) %>%

)
group_stats <- df_metrics %>%
  group_by(training_set) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(`Shared Taxa (%)`, `Predicted Load Frequency (%)`)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rho  = map_dbl(test, ~ .$estimate),
    pval = map_dbl(test, ~ .$p.value),
    R2   = rho^2
  ) %>%
  select(-test)

overall_stats <- df_metrics %>%
  summarise(
    training_set = "Overall",
    test = list(cor.test(`Shared Taxa (%)`, `Predicted Load Frequency (%)`))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rho  = map_dbl(test, ~ .$estimate),
    pval = map_dbl(test, ~ .$p.value),
    R2   = rho^2
  ) %>%
  select(-test)

stats_df <- bind_rows(overall_stats, group_stats) %>%
  mutate(
    label = sprintf(
      "ρ = %.2f\nR\u00B2 = %.2f\np = %.3g",
      rho, R2, pval
    ),
    training_set = factor(
      training_set,
      levels = c("Overall", unique(group_stats$training_set))
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(training_set) %>%
  mutate(
    x = max(df_metrics$`Shared Taxa (%)`, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
    y = max(df_metrics$`Predicted Load Frequency (%)`, na.rm = TRUE) *
        (0.95 - (row_number() - 1) * 0.10)
  )

overall_y <- stats_df %>%
  filter(training_set == "Overall") %>%
```

```{r mean centered residual sample level features}
plot_subset <- function(data, vars, title) {
  ggplot(data %>% filter(variable %in% vars),
         aes(x = training_set, y = value, fill = training_set)) +
    geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.8, color = "black", size = 0.8) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4,
               labeller = labeller(variable = feature_labels_clean[vars])) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Training Set",
                      values = c(Vandeputte2021 = "#1B1B1B",
                                 GALAXY         = "#0C58CA",
                                 MetaCardis     = "#FF8C27")) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)),
      limits = c(0,NA),
      breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 6),
      minor_breaks = waiver()
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(panel.border       = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey80", size = 0.2),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
          strip.background   = element_blank(),
          strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, margin=margin(t=5), color = "black"),
          axis.text.y        = element_text(),
          axis.title.y       = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position    = "none",
          legend.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.text        = element_text(),
          plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.ticks         = element_line(size = 0.5, color = "black")
          )
}

plot_resid <- function(data, title) {
  preds <- data %>%
    group_by(training_set, variable,loadtype) %>%
    do({
      mod     <- lm(residual ~ value, data = .)
      sdresid <- sd(resid(mod))
      grid    <- tibble(value = seq(min(.$value, na.rm=TRUE),
                                    max(.$value, na.rm=TRUE),
                                    length.out = 100))
      augment(mod, newdata = grid) %>%
        mutate(resid_sd = sdresid)
    })
  ggplot(data, aes(x = value, y = residual, fill = loadtype, color = training_set)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.6, aes(color = loadtype, fill = loadtype)) +
     geom_smooth(
      method    = "lm",
      se        = TRUE,
      color     = "white",
      aes(fill = loadtype),
      linewidth = 1.8,
      alpha     = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method    = "lm",
      se        = TRUE,
      aes(fill = loadtype, color = loadtype),
      linewidth = 1.2,
      alpha     = 0.3
    ) +
    stat_cor(
      method      = "pearson",
      aes(label    = after_stat(r.label), color = "loadtype"),
      label.x.npc = "left",
      label.y.npc = "top",
      size        = 5,
      show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name   = "Load Type",
      values = my_cols
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name   = "Load Type",
      values = alpha(my_cols, 0.3)
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      training_set ~ variable,
      scales = "free",
      switch = "x",                      
      labeller = labeller(
        variable     = feature_labels_clean,
        training_set = training_set_labels
      )
    )+
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits      = c(0, NA),               
      expand      = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)),
      breaks      = breaks_width(1),
      minor_breaks = waiver()
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_cols) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_cols) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Absolute Residual") +
    common_theme
}
```

```{r differential abundance analysis}
library(devtools)
load_all("R/ALDEx3")
library(DESeq2)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)
library(ANCOMBC)
library(metagenomeSeq)
library(MicrobiomeStat)

# ---- Differential Abundance Analysis ----
substr_patterns <- c("CFU", "MK_spike", "ITS")
clean_nested_dataframes <- function(obj, exact_names, substr_patterns) {
  if (is.data.frame(obj)) {
    if (!is.null(exact_names)) {
      obj <- obj[, !colnames(obj) %in% exact_names, drop = FALSE]
    }
    if (!is.null(substr_patterns)) {
      matches <- sapply(substr_patterns, function(p)
        grepl(p, colnames(obj), ignore.case = TRUE))
      obj <- obj[, !rowSums(matches) > 0, drop = FALSE]
    }
    return(obj)
  } else if (is.list(obj)) {
    return(lapply(obj, clean_nested_dataframes, exact_names, substr_patterns))
  } else {
    return(obj)
  }
}
aldexrepo <- lapply(predictionandtruthresults, function(study) {
  study[c("proportions", "tax", "scale")] <- NULL
  study$predictions <- clean_nested_dataframes(
    study$predictions,
    exact_names = loadcolumnstoremove,
    substr_patterns = substr_patterns
  )
  return(study)
})
is_empty_counts <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(TRUE)
  if (is.atomic(x)) return(all(is.na(x)))
  if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    return(nrow(x) == 0 || all(sapply(x, function(col) all(is.na(col)))))
  }
  if (is.list(x)) {
    return(length(x) == 0 || all(sapply(x, is_empty_counts)))
  }
  return(FALSE)
}
prune_empty_lists <- function(x) {
  if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    return(x)
  }
  if (!is.list(x)) {
    return(x)
  }
  x <- lapply(x, prune_empty_lists)
  keep_idx <- !sapply(x, function(el) {
    is.null(el) ||
    (is.list(el) && length(el) == 0) ||
    (is.atomic(el) && all(is.na(el))) ||
    (is.list(el) && all(sapply(el, function(y) {
       is.null(y) ||
       (is.atomic(y) && all(is.na(y))) ||
       (is.list(y) && length(y) == 0)
    })))
  })
  x[keep_idx]
}
aldexrepo <- lapply(aldexrepo, function(study) {
  if (!is.null(study$counts)) {
    if (is.list(study$counts) && !is.data.frame(study$counts)) {
      study$counts <- prune_empty_lists(study$counts)
    }
  }
  if (is_empty_counts(study$counts)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  return(study)
})

# ---- Remove Empty Studies ----
aldexrepo <- Filter(function(study) {
  !is_empty_counts(study$counts) &&
  !is_empty_counts(study$predictions)
}, aldexrepo)
extract_leaf_df <- function(x) {
  if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    return(x)
  }
  if (is.list(x) && length(x) > 0 && all(sapply(x, is.atomic))) {
    return(as.data.frame(x))
  }
  if (is.list(x)) {
    for (el in x) {
      df <- extract_leaf_df(el)
      if (!is.null(df)) return(df)
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
}
aldexrepo <- lapply(aldexrepo, function(study) {
  if (!is.null(study$counts)) {
    leaf_counts <- extract_leaf_df(study$counts)
    study$counts <- leaf_counts
  }
  if (!is.null(study$predictions)) {
    leaf_preds <- extract_leaf_df(study$predictions)
    study$predictions <- leaf_preds
  }
  return(study)
})

process_study_with_benchmarks <- function(study_name, study_data, checkpoint_dir = NULL) {
  message("Differential Abundance Analysis for: ", study_name)

  demo   <- study_data$studydemographics
  id_col <- demo$ID
  counts_df <- study_data$counts
  df_meta   <- study_data$metadata
  df_pred   <- study_data$predictions

  if (is.null(counts_df)) {
    message("No counts matrix for ", study_name, ". Skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (!(id_col %in% colnames(df_meta))) {
    stop("ID column '", id_col, "' not found in metadata for ", study_name, ".")
  }

  sample_id_col <- grep("^sample[._ ]?ID$", colnames(df_pred), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(sample_id_col) != 1) {
    stop("`predictions` must contain a column named `sample ID` (or `sample.ID`) for ", study_name, ".")
  }

  # 1) Get sample IDs for counts (rows are samples here)
  if (!is.null(rownames(counts_df)) && !any(rownames(counts_df) == "")) {
    sample_ids_counts <- rownames(counts_df)
  } else if (nrow(counts_df) == nrow(df_meta)) {
    sample_ids_counts <- as.character(df_meta[[id_col]])
    rownames(counts_df) <- sample_ids_counts
  } else {
    stop("Cannot infer sample IDs for counts in ", study_name, ".")
  }

  # 2) Intersect sample IDs across data sources
  meta_ids   <- as.character(df_meta[[id_col]])
  pred_ids   <- as.character(df_pred[[sample_id_col]])
  common_ids <- Reduce(intersect, list(sample_ids_counts, meta_ids, pred_ids))
  if (!length(common_ids)) {
    stop("No common sample IDs among counts, metadata, and predictions for ", study_name, ".")
  }

  # 3) Subset to common IDs 
  counts_df <- counts_df[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  df_meta   <- df_meta[match(common_ids, df_meta[[id_col]]), , drop = FALSE]
  df_pred   <- df_pred[df_pred[[sample_id_col]] %in% common_ids, , drop = FALSE]

  # 4) Covariates and complete cases
  covariate_cols <- demo$covariates
  if (is.null(covariate_cols) || !length(covariate_cols)) {
    message("Skipping study: ", study_name, " – no covariates defined.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  conds_full <- df_meta[, covariate_cols, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(conds_full) <- df_meta[[id_col]] 

  keep_idx <- complete.cases(conds_full)
  if (!any(keep_idx)) {
    message("Skipping study: ", study_name, " – zero samples have complete covariate data.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Keep only complete rows in ALL tables (preserve rownames = sample IDs)
  counts_df  <- counts_df[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  df_meta    <- df_meta[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  df_pred    <- df_pred[df_pred[[sample_id_col]] %in% df_meta[[id_col]], , drop = FALSE]
  conds_full <- conds_full[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]

  # 5) Drop rare factor levels and keep sample IDs as rownames
  for (v in covariate_cols) {
    if (!is.factor(conds_full[[v]]) && !is.character(conds_full[[v]])) next
    freq <- table(conds_full[[v]])
    rare <- names(freq[freq < 2])
    if (length(rare)) {
      drop_idx <- conds_full[[v]] %in% rare
      message("Dropping ", sum(drop_idx), " sample(s) from rare level(s) in ", v, ": ", paste(rare, collapse = ", "))
      keep2        <- !drop_idx
      conds_full   <- conds_full[ keep2, , drop = FALSE]
      counts_df    <- counts_df[ keep2, , drop = FALSE]
      df_meta      <- df_meta[   keep2, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }

  # 6) Build count matrix with samples as COLUMNS and align strictly to conds_full row order
  counts_mat <- t(as.matrix(counts_df))
  colnames(counts_mat) <- rownames(counts_df)
  sample_order <- rownames(conds_full)
  counts_mat   <- counts_mat[, sample_order, drop = FALSE]
  storage.mode(counts_mat) <- "integer"

  # 7) Prepare outputs
  final_results_list <- list()
  truth_cols <- grep("^log2_truth_", colnames(df_pred), value = TRUE)
  message("DEBUG: truth_cols = ", if (length(truth_cols)) paste(truth_cols, collapse = ", ") else "<none>")
  pred_id_vec <- as.character(df_pred[[sample_id_col]])
  names(pred_id_vec) <- pred_id_vec

  if (!length(truth_cols)) {
    n_samples <- nrow(conds_full)
    message(" >> no_scale on all ", n_samples, " samples <<")

    no_scale_res <- run_aldex3_with_benchmarks(
      countdata        = counts_mat,                 
      conds            = conds_full,                  
      scaledata        = NULL,
      scale_label      = "no_scale",
      study_name       = study_name,
      checkpoint_dir   = checkpoint_dir,
      truthsamplesubset = "no_truth_subset"
    )
    if (length(no_scale_res)) {
      no_scale_res <- purrr::imap(no_scale_res, \(df, .) {
        if (is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df))
          dplyr::mutate(df, n_samples = n_samples)
      })
    }
    final_results_list[["no_truth_subset_no_scale"]] <-
      no_scale_res[names(no_scale_res) %in% c("ALDEx3_tss", "ALDEx3_clr", "DESeq2", "limma", "ANCOM_BC", "LinDA","edgeR","metagenomeSeq")]

  } else {
    for (truth_col in truth_cols) {

      truth_map <- setNames(df_pred[[truth_col]], pred_id_vec)
      truth_all <- truth_map[rownames(conds_full)] 

      non_na_idx <- which(!is.na(truth_all))
      n_samples  <- length(non_na_idx)
      if (!n_samples) {
        message("  Skipping ", truth_col, " (0 samples).")
        next
      }

      message(" >> truth = ", truth_col, " | ", n_samples, " samples <<")

      sample_ids_sub <- rownames(conds_full)[non_na_idx]
      counts_sub     <- counts_mat[, sample_ids_sub, drop = FALSE]  
      conds_sub      <- conds_full[sample_ids_sub, , drop = FALSE] 
      truth_sub      <- truth_all[non_na_idx]

      if (length(colnames(counts_sub)) != nrow(conds_sub)) {
        message("Dimensions mismatch for ", study_name, " (", truth_col, ").")
        next
      }

      no_scale_res <- run_aldex3_with_benchmarks(
        countdata        = counts_sub,
        conds            = conds_sub,
        scaledata        = NULL,
        scale_label      = "no_scale",
        study_name       = study_name,
        checkpoint_dir   = checkpoint_dir,
        truthsamplesubset = truth_col
      )
      if (length(no_scale_res)) {
        no_scale_res <- purrr::imap(no_scale_res, \(df, .) {
          if (is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df))
            dplyr::mutate(df, n_samples = n_samples)
        })
      }
      final_results_list[[truth_col]][["no_scale"]] <-
        no_scale_res[names(no_scale_res) %in% c("ALDEx3_tss", "ALDEx3_clr", "DESeq2", "limma", "ANCOM_BC", "LinDA","edgeR","metagenomeSeq")]

      if (length(truth_sub) != length(colnames(counts_sub)) ||
          length(truth_sub) != nrow(conds_sub)) {
        message("Truth have the wrong number of samples/mismatched dimensions for ",
                study_name, " (", truth_col, ").")
        next
      }

      meas_res <- run_aldex3_with_benchmarks(
        countdata        = counts_sub,
        conds            = conds_sub,
        scaledata        = truth_sub,
        scale_label      = truth_col,
        study_name       = study_name,
        checkpoint_dir   = checkpoint_dir,
        truthsamplesubset = truth_col
      )
      if (length(meas_res)) {
        meas_res <- purrr::imap(meas_res, \(df, .) {
          if (is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df))
            dplyr::mutate(df, n_samples = n_samples)
        })
      }
      final_results_list[[truth_col]][["measured"]] <-
        meas_res[names(meas_res) %in% c(paste0("ALDEx3_", truth_col))]

      final_results_list[[truth_col]][["mlp"]] <- list()
      if (all(c("log2_mlp", "training_set", "profile") %in% colnames(df_pred))) {
        pred_df <- df_pred[df_pred[[sample_id_col]] %in% rownames(conds_full), , drop = FALSE]
        pred_df <- pred_df[!is.na(pred_df$log2_mlp), , drop = FALSE]
        if (!nrow(pred_df)) {
          message("  Skipping MLP – no non-NA predictions in this truth subset.")
        } else {
          pred_df$sample_id <- pred_df[[sample_id_col]]
          message("DEBUG MLP: raw combos → ", paste0(sort(unique(pred_df$training_set)), collapse = ", "))
          pred_df %>%
            dplyr::group_by(training_set, profile) %>%
            dplyr::group_walk(~{
              combo <- .y; grp <- .x
              training_set <- combo$training_set; profile <- combo$profile

              mlp_map <- setNames(grp$log2_mlp, grp$sample_id)
              mlp_all <- mlp_map[rownames(conds_full)]
              mlp_sub <- mlp_all[sample_ids_sub]  

              n_samples_combo <- length(mlp_sub)
              message(" >> MLP (", training_set, " / ", profile, ") | ", n_samples_combo, " samples <<")

              scale_lab <- paste0("Nishijima2024_", make.names(training_set), "_", make.names(profile))

              if (length(mlp_sub) != length(colnames(counts_sub)) ||
                  length(mlp_sub) != nrow(conds_sub)) {
                message("MLP predictions have the wrong number of samples for ",
                        study_name, " (", training_set, " / ", profile, ").")
                return(invisible(NULL))
              }

              mlp_res <- run_aldex3_with_benchmarks(
                countdata        = counts_sub,
                conds            = conds_sub,
                scaledata        = mlp_sub,
                scale_label      = scale_lab,
                study_name       = study_name,
                checkpoint_dir   = checkpoint_dir,
                truthsamplesubset = truth_col
              )
              if (length(mlp_res)) {
                mlp_res <- purrr::imap(mlp_res, \(df, nm) {
                  if (is.data.frame(df) && nrow(df)) df %>% dplyr::mutate(n_samples = n_samples_combo) else df
                })
              }
              matched_keys <- grep(scale_lab, names(mlp_res), value = TRUE)
              if (length(matched_keys) == 1) {
                savingmlpresultname <- paste0("ALDEx3_", scale_lab)
                final_results_list[[truth_col]][["mlp"]][[savingmlpresultname]] <<- mlp_res[[matched_keys]]
              } else if (length(matched_keys) > 1) {
                stop("Multiple matches found for scale_lab = ", scale_lab, ":\n", paste(matched_keys, collapse = ", "))
              } else {
                stop("No match found for scale_lab = ", scale_lab)
              }
            })
        }
      } else {
        message("DEBUG: MLP block skipped – columns ‘log2_mlp’, ‘training_set’, or ‘profile’ missing.")
      }
    }
  }

  all_empty <- all(purrr::map_lgl(final_results_list, \(lst) {
    all(purrr::map_lgl(lst, \(df) is.data.frame(df) && !nrow(df)))
  }))
  if (all_empty) {
    message("No non-empty benchmarking results for ", study_name, ". Returning NULL.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  return(final_results_list)
}

# ---- Process Studies with Benchmarks ----
aldexrepo$Kruger2024$metadata <- aldexrepo$Kruger2024$metadata$metadata
aldexresults <- list()
for (study_name in names(aldexrepo)) {
  study_data <- aldexrepo[[study_name]]
  result <- process_study_with_benchmarks(study_name, study_data, checkpoint_dir = "data/differentialabundance")
  aldexresults[[study_name]] <- result
}
```
